{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders as they do not represent completed conversions
completed_only = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of customer segments by channel
segment_by_channel = completed_only.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("Customer segment distribution by channel:")
print(segment_by_channel)

# Compute conversion rates for each channel (on completed orders only)
conversion_rate_email = completed_only[completed_only['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
conversion_rate_paid_search = completed_only[completed_only['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Compute the difference (email - paid_search)
difference = conversion_rate_email - conversion_rate_paid_search

print(f"\nConversion rate (email): {conversion_rate_email:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {conversion_rate_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
